mapper.select: /* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectApplicableLeaveTypes */ SELECT T.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , T.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , T.SYSTEM_YN AS systemYn , T.APRV_USE_YN AS typeAprvUseYn , T.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , CASE WHEN T.LEAVE_TYPE = '01' THEN IFNULL(T.MAX_APLY_DAYS, 0) - IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(U.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.LEAVE_CD = T.LEAVE_CD AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.START_DATE >= #{fiscalStartYmd} AND U.START_DATE < #{fiscalEndYmdExclusive} ), 0) ELSE IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS) - SUM(G.USED_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND G.LEAVE_CD = T.LEAVE_CD AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.EXPIRE_YN = 'N' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' ), 0) END AS balanceDays FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.SYSTEM_YN DESC, T.LEAVE_NO ASC, T.LEAVE_CD ASC

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectCompanyUsageUnit */ SELECT UP.USAGE_UNIT AS usageUnit , P.APRV_USE_YN AS policyAprvUseYn FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P JOIN TB_LEAVE_USAGE_POLICY UP ON UP.POLICY_SEQ = P.POLICY_SEQ WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.POLICY_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1
/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectNextReqId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'ATTD_REQ_ID')) FROM DUAL
/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectNextLeaveId */ SELECT CONCAT('LV', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'LEAVE_USE_ID')) FROM DUAL

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectLeaveTypeInfo */ SELECT A.SYSTEM_YN AS systemYn , A.APRV_USE_YN AS aprvUseYn , A.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , A.LEAVE_TYPE AS leaveType , A.MAX_APLY_DAYS AS maxAplyDays , A.AVAIL_TERM_TYPE AS availTermType FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.LEAVE_CD = #{leaveCd} LIMIT 1
/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectPolicyAprvUseYn */ SELECT P.APRV_USE_YN FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.POLICY_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectUserNodeSelfApproveYn */ SELECT N.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_SITE_NODE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND N.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND N.NODE_CD = U.NODE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND N.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN = 'Y' AND (N.MAIN_ADMIN_CD = U.USER_CD OR N.SUB_ADMIN_CD = U.USER_CD) LIMIT 1
